items.summary: Web administration panel (port 8080) binds to all network interfaces including public IPv6 addresses, making internal API endpoints reachable over WAN without firewall protection (related to CVE-2026-50224).

items.summary: Any connected WiFi client can fetch device info and meeting recording metadata without credentials.

items.title: Tenda RX3 GBK-to-UTF-8 Conversion auto discover stack-based overflow
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /bin/auto discover of the component GBK-to-UTF-8 Conversion. The manipulation of the argument Hostname leads to stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: Tenda RX3 fast setting wifi set improper authentication
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11 multi. Affected is an unknown function of the file /goform/fast setting wifi set. Performing a manipulation of the argument loginPwd results in improper authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: cron-parser through 5.10.0 Unbounded Memory Allocation via CronExpressionParser.parse()
items.summary: Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

items.title: D-Link R32 DHMAPI Action SetTimeSettings os command injection
items.summary: A flaw has been found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. The affected element is the function SetTimeSettings of the component DHMAPI Action Handler. This manipulation of the argument TZLocation causes os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: Maestro: grpc server authentication defaults to 'mock' (allow-all authorizer)
items.summary: A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

items.title: Apache Airflow Reflected Cross-site Scripting vulnerability in 404 Endpoint
items.summary: It was noticed an XSS in certain 404 pages that could be exploited to perform an XSS attack. Chrome will detect this as a reflected XSS attempt and prevent the page from loading. However Firefox and other browsers don't, and are vulnerable to this attack. Mitigation: The fix for this is to upgrade to Apache Airflow 1.9.0 or above.
